domain: Every exclusively borrowed arbitrary initialized [u8;128], every immutable key slice, including empty, shorter/equal/longer than 128. No requires. Original use is a subset.
property: All 128 after bytes equal old byte XOR key byte when index < key.len(); every remaining byte unchanged. Immutable key is unchanged by Rust exclusivity. No crypto theorem.
source_selection: hmac.rs HmacEngine::new short-key branch first loop only; standalone source slice, not whole HMAC
